author: WP19
summary: Defines the test populations (glob files, lexical definitions, registration call sites, add_test and discovery sites, example programs) and why no all-renderer or CTest total exists. Every one of its counts is stale at TARGET and was recomputed with the same definitions; the site had the 904/12,610 inventory and the no-total rule, but not the full population table, the call-site counts or the reporting grammar, which now live on the test-populations deep dive.

sections.heading: Four quantities that must not be exchanged
How the static counts are reproduced
Why there is no all-renderer total

concepts.text: "How many tests does CNA have?" has no context-free answer: source files, GoogleTest definitions, standalone executables and CTest registrations are different units, a configure selects one renderer or a compatible set, and cases are discovered by running the binary, so a number must name its unit and configuration.

concepts.section: Four quantities that must not be exchanged
concepts.text: Count of C++ files matched by the CnaTests glob patterns before configure filtering: the unit's 978 is stale; at TARGET the glob population is 903 and the site inventory (any test/tests path, vendored code excluded) is 904, the extra file being a linker-selection probe.

concepts.section: Four quantities that must not be exchanged
concepts.text: Lexical TEST, TEST_F and TEST_P definitions across the test trees before filtering and expansion: the unit's 12,507 is stale; TARGET has 12,610 (9,718, 2,778 and 114).

concepts.section: Four quantities that must not be exchanged
concepts.text: Direct cna_register_renderer_test call sites in renderer-family CMakeLists.txt files: the unit's 1,427 is stale; TARGET has 1,437 there and 1,492 across all CMake files, call sites rather than active tests.

concepts.section: Four quantities that must not be exchanged
concepts.text: Lexical add_test call sites across CMake files: the unit's 124 is stale; TARGET has 203, which helper expansion and conditions make unlike any configured inventory.
tokens: call sites across the CMake files

target.evidence: grep "^\s*add_test\s*\(" over modules, cmake, tools, tests and CMakeLists.txt (203)

concepts.section: Four quantities that must not be exchanged
concepts.text: Lexical gtest_discover_tests call sites: the unit's 7 is stale; TARGET has 2, both registering CnaTests in the two branches of one condition, each expanding only after the binary is built and listed.
tokens: both registering CnaTests in the two branches of one condition

concepts.section: Four quantities that must not be exchanged
concepts.text: C++ files under the modules' examples directories and the *_test.cpp subset: the unit's 979/873 are stale; TARGET has 985 and 879, and none of the 879 includes gtest/gtest.h.

concepts.section: Four quantities that must not be exchanged
concepts.text: These figures count different populations: adding them is meaningless and the largest is not the most authoritative, because a source can define many cases, a parameterised definition expands at run time, one executable becomes thousands of CTest entries and a standalone executable can exist unregistered.

concepts.section: How the static counts are reproduced
concepts.text: The source population is a sorted union of the find results rather than a sum of unchecked directory totals; macro counts match only declaration starts and remain source-definition counts, since INSTANTIATE_TEST_SUITE_P sites (84 at TARGET) and platform conditionals change runtime expansion.

target.evidence: find/grep over the TARGET tree (903; 84 INSTANTIATE lines per the site inventory)

concepts.section: How the static counts are reproduced
concepts.text: Renderer registrations need a separate derivation: helper definitions, wrapper expansion (parity-fixture loops) and nested CMake conditions mean the lexical figure is deliberately described as call sites, not registered or executed tests.
tokens: Call sites, not active tests in one build

concepts.section: Why there is no all-renderer total
concepts.text: Singular builds enter one family and multi-renderer builds only a compatible named set, while Windows-only, Apple-only and Emscripten-only identities make a universal configuration impossible; summing every family's registration sites produces a number no supported build exposes as one CTest suite.
tokens: a number that no supported build exposes as one CTest suite

concepts.section: Why there is no all-renderer total
concepts.text: PRE_TEST obtains case names by running CnaTests --gtest_list_tests, so configure-time inspection cannot know the expanded list; the authoritative count for a build comes from that built artifact and must name its renderer and feature set.
tokens: The authoritative count for a build comes from that built artifact

concepts.text: Identity counts can be settled by defining the noun: 25 public renderer identities and 21 implementation families are both correct because five GL identities share the EasyGL family; an identity is a user-selectable contract, a family a source implementation.

Static inspection cannot give the CTest count of a built tree, how many parameterised cases expand or run, which standalone registrations survive nested conditions, pass/fail/skip/timing totals, whether a pixel assertion reached a display, oracle divergence counts or code coverage.
tokens: Counts that only a run can give

concepts.text: No coverage tool is configured: no workflow uses gcov, lcov, gcovr or llvm-cov and no CMake option adds instrumentation; the one published line-coverage figure is a hand-recorded single-module report, and other "coverage" documents are API or feature inventories.
tokens: No workflow configures gcov, lcov, gcovr or llvm-cov

concepts.text: A durable result names every noun: "On commit X, the Y renderer build with features Z discovered N CTest entries; it ran R, skipped S and failed F on host H"; a source audit says "At commit X, this command found N declarations matching definition D."

CNA's comments and plans quote registration and suite totals from different dates and configurations; comments rot while reproducible definitions can be rerun, so the discipline is to make every number carry its derivation rather than to avoid numbers.
tokens: make every number carry its derivation

target.evidence: cmake/UnitTests.cmake comments (e.g. "~8 700 of this configuration's 9 117 CTests"); plans/*.md
